pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with CHECK; test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks all 3 existing rows are 0 and that done=2 is rejected.
src/index.js defaults view to open with WHERE done = 0 ORDER BY id; 'AC-2' test checks / and ?view=open after marking item 2 done.
'AC-3' test marks 3 then 1 and expects ['✓ First item','✓ Third item'], so it covers id order, only done items and the ✓ mark.
'AC-4' test expects all three items in id order with only the done one marked.
'AC-5' test checks the exact nav HTML for each view and for /; the current view is <strong> and not a link.
Object.hasOwn guard returns 400; 'AC-6' test covers Open, closed, empty string and __proto__, and checks that no <li> is listed.
'AC-7' test covers Nothing open., Nothing done yet. and No items yet. in all three views of an empty table.
traffic/routes.json lists /?view=done and /?view=all; 'AC-8' test asserts both are present. The traffic Worker appends the route to the URL as is, so the query is sent.

lenses.note: The spec has an owner go dated 2026-10-12. The change follows both decisions: the default view is open, and the view is a query parameter.
All 8 acceptance items are met and each is named by a test. All 6 state-table rows have tests. The spec was added in the first commit and not edited afterwards.

The tests assert rendered output and status codes. The only edit to an existing test is the fakeApp in test/traffic.test.js, which now records the query string; no assertion was loosened. The tests could not be run here, and CI runs them on every push.
The README describes the views. No other docs refer to the old listing behaviour.

The view value is checked with Object.hasOwn, so __proto__ is rejected. The SQL is built only from fixed strings in the VIEWS table. The empty-table check runs a COUNT query only when a view is empty.
No user input reaches the SQL or the HTML unescaped; titles are escaped. The relaxed route regex still rejects spaces and #. No instructions planted in the repository.
The page is minimal server-rendered HTML with no stylesheet or UI components. The ✓ marks and nav links are covered by the AC tests.
No browser or preview exists, and the PR states there are no screenshots. The rendered HTML is covered by the tests.

The claims match the diff: the behaviour change, the 400 on other view values, the traffic-check relaxation and its tests, the migration and the README. There is no assets commit or merge in the range.
